data.fund_type: An Open ended equity scheme investing in companies demonstrating sustainable practices across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) theme
data.investment_objective: To generate long term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of companies demonstrating sustainable practices across Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) parameters. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments of companies with favorable Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria (including units issued by REITs):- 80 - 100% Other Equity and equity related instruments (including units issued by REITs):- 0-20% Debt and money market instruments:- 0-20% Units issued by  InvITs:- 0-10%
data.exit_load: For redemptions / switch outs (including SIP/STP): within 15 days from the date of allotment of units, irrespective of the amount of investment: 1% No exit load shall be applicable on switches from Regular Plan to Direct Plan and vice versa, under the same scheme.
